paragraphs: CampusFlow helps students turn course materials into organized summaries, practice quizzes, and study conversations. Users can save their results and return to them across sessions.
A static JavaScript frontend connects to Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL, and TypeScript Edge Functions. AI generation runs through OpenRouter on the backend.
features: Analyze PDF, TXT, and CSV files and group related materials by course.
Extract course topics, schedules, deadlines, and important policies.
Save course summaries to a personal dashboard.
Generate practice quizzes, save answers, and request explanations for incorrect answers.
Ask follow-up study questions and reopen saved conversations.

whatItDoes.text: CampusFlow helps students turn course materials into organized summaries, practice quizzes, and study conversations. Users can save their results and return to them across sessions.

requirements.text: Keep OpenRouter keys, service-role keys, secret keys, and login tokens out of browser code and source control.
It does not apply migrations or configure the provider key or CORS origin.
Password recovery is not implemented; the Sign In page currently contains a placeholder link.
